final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry line by line, extracting only ERROR and CRITICAL level entries (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC in the required format. Extracted the message after the service name on the first line. Collected the last line of any traceback as the exception or null if none. Summed repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Aggregated counts by service. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.
